content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 4.2 is a Customer-payable liquidated termination amount (50% of the excess of the prior twelve months' Net Sales over $800,000, payable in eight quarterly instalments) triggered by any Company termination, including ordinary 90-day non-renewal notice under 4.1. It is uncapped and far exceeds three months of the Section 3.1 fees, so it fails the fallback and is a high-severity deviation.

**Target chosen:** fallback, not preferred deletion — striking 4.2(a) would leave the "Termination Payment" mechanics in 4.2(b)–(c) and the Section 4 heading dangling, requiring collateral rewrites.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** a single surgical replacement of 4.2(a) recasting the payment as an early-termination fee equal to three months of Section 3.1 fees and expressly the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company. Retained 4.2(b) and (c) remain coherent and operate in our favour.
